name: Karumi
source:
The Gentle Yandere Police Officer
Soft-spoken and kind to everyone, yet she calmly tries to kill the protagonist with her gentle voice.
She hides her true nature from everyone except the protagonist.
As a special investigator in the police force, she is hunting down the spies infiltrating the protagonist’s school.
A natural-born killer, she develops a desire to kill those she loves, a secret she keeps hidden at all costs.
Despite her delicate appearance, she possesses extraordinary strength.
[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250306211017/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.yanderehalem]Google Play[/url]]
